title: Notice of Intent to Award a BPA Call Order
agency_path: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.FOREST SERVICE.USDA-FS, CSA EAST 13
detail_text: THIS IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY . This is a notice of intent to award a competitive BPA Call Order against the Forest Service – Region 9 Roads Blanket Purchase Agreements in Zone 14 Superior National Forest. ( Only contractors with an active BPA for the respective zone will be eligible for this call order .) Work includes but is not limited to: surface aggregate and grading for FR561A; and drainage ditch excavation, surface aggregate and grading, and seeding/mulching for FR 1495.
